title: From Individual-Based Models to General Stochastic Reaction Diffusion Equations
summary: In this article, we construct, for a broad class of one-dimensional stochastic reaction-diffusion equations, a sequence of spatially-structured individual-based models whose rescaled empirical processes converge to the solution of the equation.
